description: Periodically connect to SQL and record an AssetObservation on the target external asset — surfaces health metrics in the Dagster UI without triggering a pipeline run.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Asset key of the ExternalSqlAsset to observe

connection_string_env_var.label: Connection String Env Var
connection_string_env_var.description: Env var with SQLAlchemy connection string

watermark_column.label: Watermark Column
watermark_column.description: Column for latest value metric (e.g. updated_at). Used to derive the DataVersion in the native path.

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
